serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Britannia.face.normal
Britannia: Oh, it's you. Annalie’s friend.
You: Do you want something?
Britannia: What’s up with that cocky attitude? Gross⛤~
Britannia: I heard that one of Annalie’s models bailed LOL⛤~ It’s so over for her.
You: We found a replacement.
Britannia: Oh⛤~ You did it? No matter. She won’t be able to adjust in time. 
You: We will see. 
#Britannia.Eyes.Irritated+Britannia.Mouth.Angry
Britannia: You and that other girl are really annoying, you know that? Hanging out with that loser Annalie. It’s seriously so uncool.
#Britannia.face.normal
You: What’s your problem with her anyway? 
Britannia: I just don’t like cocky people who don’t know their place. That’s all.
Britannia: She thinks that only because she has some talent she can just waltz in and leave us all in the dust? Not on my watch.
Britannia: I asked her to join an internship with me and she refused and opened her little stupid shop instead. Look at us now. I’m already an established designer and she’s some glorified clerk. Serves her right.
You: What? You are mad that she didn’t go to the same internship as you? That’s kinda…
#Britannia.face.angry
#Britannia.Hands.Flip
Britannia: I-It’s not like that, stupid! What does some stupid guy like you know anyway? Stuuuupid⛤~! 
#Britannia.Hands.Normal
#Britannia.Eyes.Irritated+Britannia.Mouth.Normal
Britannia: It’s a lonely industry, you know. Her leaving me was bound to happen sooner or later.
Britannia: In hindsight, I prefer it this way. I wouldn’t have gone as far as I did if I had tried to play pretend that there was some kind of friendship.
You: I don’t know the details, but it sounds to me like you just miss her.
Britannia: Shut up, man.
#Britannia.face.normal
Britannia: Here come Annalie’s designs. Let’s see if it is any good.
